sloka: पिता दशरथो हृष्टो ब्रह्मा लोकाधिपो यथा ।ते च अपि मनुज व्याघ्रा वैदिक अध्ययने रताः ॥१-१८-३६॥
transliteration: pitā daśaratho hṛṣṭo brahmā lokādhipo yathā ।te ca api manuja vyāghrā vaidika adhyayane ratāḥ ॥1-18-36॥

translations.english: Then the virtuous king Dasaratha deliberated with his priests and kinsmen about the marriage of his sons.
